messages:
irina: heads-up: planning a gradual rollout of structured-output (function-calling + strict schema mode) next Thursday. initial audience: 15% global traffic, gated by plan and region. want to align on compatibility flags, SDK changes, telemetry, and a safety pause.

alex: sounds good. prefer gating by plan (starter/pro/enterprise) so enterprise can opt-in later. also region gating for eu/apac to respect compliance windows.

santiago: note: current JS and Python SDKs will ignore unknown tool frames and return plain text. we've added server-side flag `so.experimental_enable` to toggle structured responses. older SDKs will keep textual fallbacks unless they send the new client header.

marie: sdk plan: ship RC that exposes safe parse helpers and opt-in parsing callback. RC target: Tue EOD. GA after a couple days of canary monitoring.

irina: two questions for infra/observability: 1) which metrics/logs to capture for regression detection? 2) what's the expected server fallback when schema validation fails?

santiago: propose metrics: `so.attempts` (count of structured attempts), `so.schema_errors` (validation errors), `so.rendered_fallbacks` (server-rendered textual fallbacks), plus a sampled dump `so.sampled_dumps` at 0.5% for triage. include client SDK version in logs (header `X-Client-SDK`).

marie: SDK will add `X-Client-SDK` and a flag `X-SO-Support: 1` once RCs are out.

alex: fallback behavior suggestion: prefer non-failing experience; algorithm:
```
if valid_schema: return structured + header X-SO-Mode: structured
elif can_safely_render_text: return rendered_text + header X-SO-Fallback: rendered
else: respond 200 with a short plain text error and telemetry note
```
we should avoid returning malformed JSON silently.

irina: prefer explicit error path for unknown corruption. add telemetry event whenever fallback triggers so product teams can react. also want an automated pause rule: if `so.schema_errors` > 3% of `so.attempts` in any 10-minute window for the canary cohort, the rollout should auto-pause.

deploy-bot: scheduled rollout: feature-flag update `so.experimental_enable` -> phase 1 (15%) at 2026-03-25T10:00Z.

marie: QA will assemble a canary test suite covering common integrations (zapier-like, slo bots, internal actions). will include tests for header presence and payload sanity.

qa-bot: test-suite created: structured-output-canary-v1. Includes asserts: schema conformance, X-SO-Fallback header, sample telemetry event, sampled dump pull. Runs nightly and on canary flip.

santiago: operational note: treat clients < 2.5.0 as incompatible. server will ignore schema enforcement for requests that show older sdk in header. adding denylist on request parsing layer.

irina: great. action items:
- santiago: add telemetry instrumentation + denylist enforcement (owner)
- marie: publish SDK RC + docs + changelog examples (owner)
- qa: create canary test set and runbook (owner)
- alex: coordinate plan/region gating and customer opt-in comms (owner)
- irina: create rollout ticket, wire pause monitor and dashboard, link owners (owner)

alex: i'll prep a short support note describing what customers will observe when fallback happens and how to opt-in.

marie: we'll include migration examples and best practices in the RC docs.

irina: thanks. plan: flip phase 1 next Thu and observe first 60 minutes closely. post any blocking concerns here.

santiago: will post dashboard link after metrics are live.

irina: :thumbsup:
